entries.title: Psalms 28:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Towards - Towards the holy of holies, because there the ark was; from whence God gave oracular answers to his people.

entries.title: Psalms 28:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Draw not - Do not drag me; as thou dost these, to execution and destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 28:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Regard not - The providential works of God towards his people.

entries.title: Psalms 28:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: I am helped - He speaks of it as past, because God assured him by his spirit, that he had heard and accepted his prayers.
